package consumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/blog"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
)

func consume(ctx context.Context, backend db.Queryer) ([]*project.BlogPostObject, error) {
	objects, err := project.BindObjects()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	source := blog.PostObjects.Using(backend).OrderBy(blog.PostFields.ID.Asc())
	selected := objects.BlogPost.SelectRelated(source)
	if _, err := selected.ParseDynamic("author"); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return selected.WithAuthor().All(ctx)
}

func count(ctx context.Context, backend db.Queryer) (int64, int64, error) {
	objects, err := project.BindObjects()
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	selected := objects.BlogPost.SelectRelated(blog.PostObjects.Using(backend))
	typed, err := selected.WithAuthor().Count(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	dynamic, err := selected.ParseDynamic("reviewer")
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	other, err := dynamic.Count(ctx)
	return typed, other, err
}

func multiple(ctx context.Context, backend db.Queryer) ([]*project.BlogPostObject, error) {
 objects, err := project.BindObjects()
 if err != nil { return nil, err }
 source := blog.PostObjects.Using(backend).OrderBy(blog.PostFields.ID.Asc())
 return objects.BlogPost.SelectRelated(source).WithReviewer().WithAuthor().All(ctx)
}
